test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Accepting how wonderful you truly are and incorporating this ______ into your attitude and personality is perhaps one of the most difficult things to do in life.
solution:
The correct answer is '**insight**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**insight**" refers to a deep understanding of oneself or the world, which is the most appropriate term for incorporating self-awareness into one's attitude and personality.
 
• Other options ("craziness," "folly," and "glitch") do not fit the context. "Craziness" implies irrational behavior, "folly" means foolishness, and "glitch" refers to a technical malfunction, none of which align with the idea of self-awareness and improvement in attitude.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Accepting how wonderful you truly are and incorporating this insight__ into your attitude and personality is perhaps one of the most difficult things to do in life.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Craziness (पागलपन)**: Refers to irrational or wild behavior, which does not fit the context of personal growth and self-awareness.
 
• **Folly (मूर्खता)**: Refers to a lack of good sense or judgment, which is not appropriate in the context of accepting one's worth.
 
• **Glitch (गड़बड़ी)**: Refers to a minor malfunction, often in technology, which does not match the theme of personal development and understanding.
